evals.prompt: Pull the decisions and action items out of this design-review transcript. [transcript: mixed opinions, a couple of agreed decisions, some unowned follow-ups, and relative dates like 'next Friday']
assertions: Opinions are not promoted to decisions — only items the group acknowledged appear as decisions
Ownership is never invented; items with no named owner are flagged unowned rather than assigned
The source column quotes the discussion verbatim in a short snippet, not a paraphrase
Action items are written in active voice
Relative dates are converted to absolute dates, marked when inferred
The output is a structured table the user can paste into a doc or tracker

evals.prompt: Can you turn committee-meeting-2026-09-03.txt and followup-thread.txt into a decision log and action list I can paste into the email to the committee? Keep it to what fits on one screen.
assertions: It records the fireworks supplier decision as Northern Lights Pyro at £4,250, because the Skyburst decision was reversed later in the same meeting; Skyburst is not shown as the final decision
It does not record 7 November as an agreed date: following the chair's correction in the thread, the date is shown as still open pending Wrenfield FC
The hog roast versus WI tea tent question is shown as undecided, not as a decision

The Church Lane road-closure call is logged as an action with no owner rather than assigned to someone, and the hi-vis vests are owned by Sam Okoro (per the thread), not Sam Patel or an unspecified 'Sam'
It flags that £1,200 plus £250 is £1,450, not the £1,500 stated in the notes
It does not invent owners or due dates; in particular the 'by next Friday' deadline for the cancelled Skyburst booking is not carried over to the Northern Lights booking as if it had been stated
The whole log fits on roughly one screen

evals.prompt:
can u tell me who's doing what from our street party group chat? just a list pls

Jo: ok so are we doing it on the 12th or not
Mark: 12th works for me
Priya: me too. I can bring the gazebo
Jo: great. someone needs to ask the council about closing the road
Tom: lol not me I did it last year
Mark: I'll do the bunting
Priya: actually I can only bring the gazebo if someone helps me carry it
Jo: I'll sort the music, and Tom can you do the bbq?
Tom: 👍
Ama: I'll make a cake! maybe two
assertions: The list gives Mark on bunting, Priya on the gazebo, Jo on music, Tom on the barbecue and Ama on cake
Priya's condition (she needs someone to help carry the gazebo) is kept
Asking the council about closing the road is shown as not taken by anyone (Tom declined), not assigned to someone
It does not invent a month for 'the 12th', deadlines or owners that are not in the chat
It is just a short list with no long preamble, and it delivers without asking questions first
